title: Blonde Toddler Girl in Playsuit on Front Porch, 1939 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length snapshot of a young blonde toddler girl posing outside on her family home's front doorstep. She wears a summer playsuit with a small belt buckle, white ankle socks, white walking shoes, and a delicate bow ribbon in her hair. She stands on a woven doormat in front of a white panel door flanked by brick and masonry stonework, captured under bright natural sunlight casting sharp shadows.
